claim.en: Langová ran for PS in the 2023 parliamentary election (list position 104) and received 1,599 votes; she was then head of the city gallery.
claim.sk: Langová kandidovala v parlamentných voľbách 2023 za PS (104. miesto) a získala 1 599 hlasov; vtedy bola vedúcou mestskej galérie.

findings.identity: PhDr. Janette Langová from Prešov, aged 50 in 2023 (53 now), cultural institutions manager.
